title: The 2026 admissions campaign has started
summary: Applications are open at all study levels, from vocational programmes to postgraduate study. Check deadlines, documents and the application procedure.

body.text: On 20 June, Admiral Ushakov State Maritime University opened applications for the 2026/2027 academic year. Applications are accepted for bachelor, specialist, master, vocational and postgraduate programmes.

items: Through the applicant portal — the main route.
In person at the admissions office, 93 Prospekt Lenina.
By post, subject to document requirements.

body.title: Important
body.text: Before applying, check the entrance examinations and individual achievements for your chosen programme.
The admissions office is open every day during the campaign. Phone: +7 (8617) 71-75-25.
